entities.summary: The Grodzka Gate – NN Theatre Centre is a cultural institution based in Lublin. It is housed in the Grodzka Gate, also known as the Jewish Gate, which historically used to be a passage from the Christian to the Jewish part of the city. In its activities, the Centre focuses on issues of cultural heritage. The Polish-Jewish past of Lublin is the corner stone of the art and educational programmes carried out by the "Gate". Grodzka Gate – NN Theatre is a theatre building in Europe, established in 1998. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
